origin.description: Draw points, or a step line when the type contains s.
origin.details: Type s sorts on x. Between each successive pair it keeps the new x with the previous y, which is the horizontal stroke of the step.
origin.value: The coordinates of the step line.
origin.example:
coords <- NULL
assignInNamespace("panel.lines", function(x, y, ...) { coords <<- list(x = x, y = y) }, "lattice")
panel.xyplot(c(1, 3, 2), c(4, 5, 6), type = "s")
cat(coords$x, coords$y, "\n")
